description: Get a folder's details and one page of its videos. Returns {id, name, parent_folder_id, status, videos: [...], pagination: {page, limit, total_count, total_pages, has_next, has_prev}}. Only videos directly in this folder; subfolders are not included (use panda_list_folders). To list every video of a large folder, keep calling with page+1 while pagination.has_next is true. Default 20 videos per page, max 20.
name: panda_get_folder
title: Get Folder
